ext_data.TCGplayer Tip: This Pikachu card was one of 25 cards which were available in booster packs that came in McDonald’s Happy Meals for a limited time in 2021. Each of the 25 cards came in foil and nonfoil and featured the “Pikachu 25” logo, in honor of the 25th anniversary of Pokémon Red & Green.
